prose: John McHugh is a scholar of Middle-East & Native American archeo-astronomy, who has found an incredible linguistic explanation for mythological miracle stories. These scriptural pseudo-histories have long been believed to be founded in real events of the distant past, yet with McHugh's examination of the Sumerian/Akkadian cuneiform languages and star-atlases, the stellar origins of theological teachings may have been discovered at last.
